title: Preallocate DML insert data keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when DML insert paths build data:<table>:<row_id> keys from known component lengths.
implementation: Added insert_data_key_for_row_id() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:<row_id>.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: DML insert data-key construction now reserves capacity from known table and row-id lengths while preserving insert, upsert, insert-select, RETURNING, and index behavior.
